scope: Eight public repositories inventoried at fixed commits. Close reading covers the fitting/evolution/observable/control-flow files listed below, not every notebook, historical variant, grid file or every third-party dependency. The SoLID projection candidate was checked remotely for provenance and excluded as an original KPSY implementation. No full physics fit or NLO derivation was reproduced.

findings.detail: version defaults to 0; published wrapper config has no version override; selects pdf1/ff1. Separate version JAM20+ selects pdf2/ff2.
default collinear scale dependence is log(log(Q2/lambda2)/log(Q20/lambda2)) added to shape parameters, not CSS TMD evolution or the separate Mellin solver.
AUTCollins with both pT and eta specified has no computation branch; test observes KeyError for empty storage. Does not establish an error in published fitted results.
cache membership tests four fields but writes and reads five; repeated identical evaluations recompute denominator. Complete bin cuts also must enter any replacement cache key.
jperp2==0 means a jT-integrated observable; it must not be mapped to a physical differential jT=0 point.
COMPASS Collins sign includes -1; older HERMES uses depolarization factor whereas HERMES2020 branch does not. Per-publication metadata is required.
non-BESIII outputs are multiplied by 100. Unit conversion cannot be inferred globally.
Native Windows Python cannot import fcntl; Linux/WSL2 runtime needed before toolchain readiness can be assessed.
402 FeynFacet Git blobs match SHA256SUMS; Windows CRLF accounts for all observed checkout hash differences.
